newsitem.title: USA: Ballantyne Q1 net surges as sales up 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ballantyne Q1 net surges as sales up 30 pct.

text.p: Ballantyne of Omaha Inc on Tuesday said a 82 percent rise in first-quarter earnings reflected increased sales, reduced interest expense and a lower tax rate.

The projection equipment maker said net income in the first quarter climbed to $1.6 million, or $0.17 a share, from $862,174, or $0.13, in the same period of 1996. Sales climbed 30 percent to $14.7 million from $11.4 million.
The company also said its recent acquisition of Xenotech would add to its earnings in 1997 and would more than double revenue generated by its spotlight division.
Ballantyne shares were up 1/4 at 16-1/4 early Tuesday afternoon.
